name: architecture-diagram
description: Standalone HTML architecture diagrams with card layouts, SVG connectors, and resource allocation tables built from spreadsheets, images, or text requirements.

interface.shortDescription: Turn spreadsheets and images into HTML architecture diagrams
interface.longDescription: Read resource spreadsheets, architecture photos or screenshots, and text requirements, then produce a single standalone HTML file with card-based network and environment zones, SVG connectors, and role-based resource allocation tables with capacity totals.
defaultPrompt: Build an HTML architecture diagram and resource allocation plan from this spreadsheet.
Redraw this architecture screenshot as HTML cards with SVG connectors.
Update the resource allocation table in this architecture diagram HTML.
